summary.name: 笔灵AI写作 (Biling AI)
summary.one_liner: 笔灵AI写作 is a Chinese-language AI writing assistant website offering article writing, thesis outlining and drafting, PPT generation, speech scripts, AI-text reduction and plagiarism-rate reduction tools.
use_cases: Generating a thesis outline and full academic paper draft
Creating PPT slides and matching speaker notes from a topic or article
Reducing AI-writing traces before submitting an essay
Lowering plagiarism similarity rate on CNKI, VIP or Wanfang checks
Drafting work reports, business plans or resumes
Continuing or polishing an existing document
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a suite of AI writing tools in Chinese. The AI writing module covers article drafting and document continuation, rewriting, expanding and polishing text, with scenario templates for resumes, official documents and work reports. The thesis module generates an editable outline from keywords in about 60 seconds, then drafts a long paper that follows the outline and an academic format, with templates such as journal articles and literature reviews. The PPT module generates slides from a topic or article and offers 17+ scenario templates, plus a matching speech script. A separate section offers AI-trace reduction and plagiarism-rate reduction, claiming to work with CNKI, VIP (维普) and Wanfang checks. The page also mentions an AI universal assistant with features such as translation and research, with legal and psychological consultation marked as coming later.
notable: Thesis outline generation in about 60 seconds, with editable outlines
AI-trace reduction and plagiarism-rate reduction claimed to work with CNKI, VIP and Wanfang
Matching speaker script generated alongside PPT slides
Refund promise if AI detection rate exceeds 15% on supported platforms
caveats: Membership and paid tiers are referenced (成为会员) but pricing details are not on the page
Legal and psychological consultation features are marked as 'coming soon'
Marketing-heavy page; user-count and detection-rate claims are self-reported and unverified
